PLAN "12-Week Advanced Resistance Program for Perimenopause Client (2026-06-01 Start) Summary" 
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve overall strength and structural balance with safe perimenopause considerations"
  GOAL fat_loss:
    name "Support body composition changes with fat loss while preserving lean mass"
  GOAL testing:
    name "End-of-Phase 3 1RM testing to assess maximal strength progression"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower/Upper Balance A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          running 12 minutes steady_state
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Thursday hot_yoga 60m "Hot Yoga A":
        main:
          hot_yoga_session 60m rpe 5
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Friday fasted_morning_HIIT 20m "Fasted HIIT A":
        main:
          hiit_session 20m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          mobility_routine 3 minutes
      NUTRITION PLAN
        daily targets and macros as in Phase 1 plan
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower/Upper Balance B":
        main:
          front_squat 4x6
          bent_over_row 4x8
          bench_press 4x6
          step_up 3x12 per leg
        cardio:
          rowing 8 minutes
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Thursday hot_yoga 60m "Hot Yoga B"
      DAY Saturday fasted_morning_HIIT 20m "Fasted HIIT B"
      NUTRITION PLAN continuation and Phase 1 notes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Lower/Upper Strength C":
        main:
          squat 5x5
          barbell_row 4x8
          bench_press 5x5
          walking_lunge 3x12 per leg
        cardio:
          incline_walk 15 minutes
        cooldown:
          calves_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Thursday hot_yoga 60m "Hot Yoga D"
      NUTRITION PLAN
    WEEK 6 cont:
      DAY Wednesday training 65m "Hypertrophy Core/Back":
        main:
          deadlift 3x8
          lat_pulldown 3x12
          rear_delt_fly 3x12
          pallof_press 3x12 per side
        cardio:
          stair_climber 6 minutes
      DAY Saturday hot_yoga 60m "Hot Yoga E"
      NUTRITION PLAN
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Strength Focus D":
        main:
          squat 4x5
          bench_press 4x5
          deadlift 3x5
          bent_over_row 3x6
        cardio:
          running 10 minutes
        cooldown:
          full_body_relax 3 minutes
      DAY Thursday hot_yoga 60m "Hot Yoga F"
      DAY Saturday fasted_morning_HIIT 12m
      NUTRITION PLAN
    WEEK 10 cont:
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Accessory Emphasis & Cardio":
        main:
          hip_thrust 4x8
          leg_curl 3x12
          lat_pulldown 3x10
          face_pull 3x12
        cardio:
          cycling 12 minutes + 4 minutes at 75% effort
        NUTRITION PLAN
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Peak Strength A":
        main:
          squat 5x3
          bench_press 5x3
          deadlift 4x3
        cardio:
          rowing 8 minutes
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Thursday hot_yoga 60m "Hot Yoga H"
      DAY Sunday fasted_morning_HIIT 10m
      NUTRITION PLAN
    WEEK 14+ cont:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Deload/Retention":
        main:
          squat 3x8
          bench_press 3x8
          barbell_row 3x8
        cardio:
          walking 20 minutes
        cooldown:
          mobility_routine 2 minutes
      DAY Thursday hot_yoga 60m "Hot Yoga I"

        - optional longer aerobic session weekly 20–40 minutes
        - fasted HIIT optional; monitor vasomotor symptoms
        - hot yoga integrated on Phase 1–4 days

        - Phase-aligned targets with protein, calcium, vitamin D

    - Optional end-of-Phase 3 1RM testing (Phase 3 Week 12 or Phase 3 Week 4 window)
